test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Anjani can do a certain piece of work in 12 days. Anjani and Khushbu can together do the same work in 9 days, and Anjani, Khushbu and Sushmita can do the same work together in 8 days. In how many days can Anjani and Sushmita do the same work together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(12, 9, 8) = 72 units.

Efficiency: **Anjani** = 6, **Anjani + Khushbu** = 8, **Anjani + Khushbu + Sushmita** = 9.

Sushmita efficiency = (A+K+S) − (A+K) = 9 − 8 = 1.

Combined efficiency (Anjani + Sushmita) = 6 + 1 = 7.

**Time taken** = 72 ÷ 7 = 72/7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 72/7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **Anjani** = 12 days, **Anjani + Khushbu** = 9 days, **Anjani + Khushbu + Sushmita** = 8 days.

**Formula:** Total Work = LCM of individual days; Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

⇒ Efficiency of **Sushmita** = (Efficiency of A + K + S) − (Efficiency of A + K)

⇒ Efficiency of **Sushmita** = 9 − 8 = 1 unit/day.

⇒ Efficiency of **Anjani + Sushmita** = 6 + 1 = 7 units/day.

⇒ Time taken by **Anjani and Sushmita** = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time = 72/7 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 72/7 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Work Concept

Total work is usually assumed as the **LCM (Least Common Multiple)** of the number of days taken by individuals to simplify calculations.

Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is **inversely proportional** to the time taken. If time taken is T₁ and T₂, the ratio of efficiency is E₁ : E₂ = T₂ : T₁.

Combined Work Formula

If two people do work in A and B days respectively, they together finish it in (A × B) ÷ (A + B) days.</p
